# testing_const_empty_set_delete (Resource)

ConstEmptySetDelete Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_const_empty_set_delete" "my_constemptysetdelete" {
  groups = [
    {
      provider = "...my_provider..."
      region   = "...my_region..."
      replicas = 10
    }
  ]
  scope_id = "...my_scope_id..."
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_const_empty_set_delete.my_testing_const_empty_set_delete
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_const_empty_set_delete.my_testing_const_empty_set_delete "..."
```
